text.content:
Sect: Sabbat

A practical clan with no known Antediluvian founder, the Panders are made up of Caitiff childer Embraced into the Sabbat, who have banded together as a clan of their own rather than remain without one. Young, rowdy, and eager to prove themselves, they have little use for pretensions of clan superiority.

Disciplines: Panders have no specific clan Disciplines; they choose and learn Disciplines as Caitiff do, drawing from any available source.

Advantage: Panders carry no innate advantage of their own.

Disadvantage: Panders likewise carry no inherent disadvantage - the blood of Caine runs so polluted, weak, or subverted in them that none of the traditional clan banes or benefices apply. Few Panders ever achieve significant Sabbat Status, and no Pander may begin the game lower than Ninth Generation.

Organization: Panders rarely form their own packs of significance, more often filling out the ranks of mixed-clan packs and proving themselves through deeds rather than pedigree.
